title: Docker container statistics
description: Show the CPU, memory, network and I/O usage of the containers in real time
notes: Windows & Linux: Ctrl+C to quit. --no-stream for a one-off display.

windowsExamples.description: Show the statistics with a custom format (name, CPU, memory).

linuxExamples.description: Show a snapshot of the CPU statistics with a simple format.
